title: Multiply Decimals

widgets.component: 'Round to estimate: about how much should the deli meat cost?' and 'A student answered $238.00. What went wrong?'
widgets.root: Neither stem contains a quantity: the deli meat (3.5 pounds at $6.80 per pound) is in the config scenario only, so 5.2 asks for an estimate of something the page never states and 5.3 asks what went wrong in a calculation that is not shown.
widgets.replacement: Rewrite with the data: 5.2 'A family buys 3.5 pounds of deli meat at $6.80 per pound. Round each number to estimate: about how much should the deli meat cost?' (about $28); 5.3 'For 3.5 pounds at $6.80 per pound, a student wrote $238.00. What went wrong?' (point in the wrong place; 35 × 680 = 23,800 needs 3 places).
